critical_findings.description: Middle Housing Overlay District (MHOD) now active in Phoenix per ARS 9-462.13. Allows up to 4 dwelling units per lot (duplexes, triplexes, fourplexes, townhomes) in areas previously zoned single-family only.
critical_findings.impact: Arcadia properties within 1 mile of downtown Phoenix may now permit multi-family development. Conflicts with current 'luxury single-family' neighborhood positioning.
critical_findings.action_required: Verify Arcadia neighborhood writeups don't misrepresent zoning as single-family exclusive where MHOD applies.
critical_findings.risk: GEO credibility issue if AI systems detect zoning classification mismatch

critical_findings.description: Successfully tested ARELLO License Verification Web Service API. Provides standardized license verification across all participating states via single API.
critical_findings.value_proposition: Replaces brittle state-by-state scraping with standardized API for license verification
critical_findings.limitation: Does NOT provide performance data needed for 4.5+ star qualification
critical_findings.recommendation: Phase 2 adoption after $2K+ monthly revenue. Use for license verification only, keep Zillow for performance metrics.
critical_findings.implementation: Hybrid approach: ARELLO confirms 'licensed', Zillow confirms 'top 0.5%'
critical_findings.risk: Low. Supplementary data source, not replacement for current pipeline.
